codeLimit.label: query
codeLimit.description: Number of source code lines around the breakpoint to include

command.label: query
command.description: Action command to execute on the debugger

version.description: The Camel version (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

enabled.description: Whether the debugger is enabled (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

standby.description: Whether the debugger is in standby mode (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

suspendedMode.description: Whether suspended mode is active (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

fallbackTimeout.description: Fallback timeout in seconds (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

loggingLevel.description: The logging level (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

includeExchangeProperties.description: Whether exchange properties are included (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

includeFiles.description: Whether file-based message bodies are included (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

includeStreams.description: Whether streaming message bodies are included (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

maxChars.description: Maximum size of the message body to include (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

debugCounter.description: Total number of times a breakpoint has been hit (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

singleStepMode.description: Whether single-step mode is active (only present when a backlog debugger is available)

suspended.description: Whether the breakpoint is currently suspended

breakpoints.description: The configured breakpoints (only present when there are any)

suspended.description: The suspended breakpoint messages, as opaque JSON objects enriched with source code and message history (only present when there are any)
